narratives.body: OneFootball reports that Martin Demichelis praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Champions League match between Real Madrid and RB Leipzig at the Bernabeu. Yardbarker and Yahoo both headline that RB Leipzig boss Martin Demichelis raves about Yan Diomande before the clash with Real Madrid.
narratives.headline: Demichelis praises Diomande ahead of Madrid clash

narratives.body: Goal.com reports that Martin Demichelis insists Franco Mastantuono is built for Real Madrid despite his loan spell at Fiorentina, noting that the player needs time to develop.
narratives.headline: Demichelis: Mastantuono built for Real Madrid
